footnote_text: On October 23, 2026, the Reporting Person elected to convert 5,159,999 Class B ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share ("Class B Ordinary Shares") of Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp. (the "Issuer") held by the Reporting Person into Class A ordinary shares of the Issuer, par value $0.0001 ("Class A Ordinary Shares") on a one-for-one basis for no consideration. || Eagle Equity Partners IV, LLC is the record holder of the securities reported herein. Mr. Eli Baker, Mr. Jeff Sagansky, and Mr. Harry Sloan are the managing members of Eagle Equity Partners IV, LLC. Each managing member has one vote, and the approval of a majority is required to approve the action. Under the so-called "rule of three," if voting and dispositive decisions regarding an entity's securities are made by three or more individuals, and voting or dispositive decisions require the approval of a majority of those individuals, then none of the individuals is deemed a beneficial owner of the entity's securities. Based on the foregoing, no individual managing member of Eagle Equity Partners IV, LLC exercises voting or dispositive control over any of the securities held by the entity, even those in which he holds a pecuniary interest. Accordingly, each managing member will not be deemed to have or share beneficial ownership of the securities held by Eagle Equity Partners IV, LLC.
